purpose: A pending detached middle ignores a temporary send payload, returns its copied object cache without advancing, then consumes the actual child return/tail through its active outer.

<?php
class PendingSendCache17 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class PendingSendArgument17 { function __destruct() { echo "S|"; } }
function pendingSendChild17() { echo "C|"; yield new PendingSendCache17; echo "L|"; return 23; }
function pendingSendMiddle17() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "R|", $reply, "|"; yield 13; return 29; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function pendingSendOuter17() { try { echo "O|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "Q|", $reply, "|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$child = pendingSendChild17(); $middle = pendingSendMiddle17(); $outer = pendingSendOuter17();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next();
echo "H|", $middle->current() instanceof PendingSendCache17 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); echo "D|";
$snapshot = $middle->send(new PendingSendArgument17); echo "V|", $snapshot instanceof PendingSendCache17 ? 1 : 0, "|K|", $middle->key() === null ? 1 : 0, "|";
$outer->next(); echo "N|", $outer->current(), "|"; $outer->next(); unset($outer, $middle); echo "U|"; unset($snapshot); echo "E";

purpose: Argument evaluation retires outer/middle CVs before send; the actual method receiver alone retains the pending detached middle and its present-false cache through argument cleanup and restored middle finally.

<?php

function pendingSoleMiddle17() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function pendingSoleOuter17() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function pendingSoleDrop17() { unset($GLOBALS["outer"], $GLOBALS["middle"]); echo "D|"; return new PendingSoleArgument17; }
$child = pendingSoleChild17(); $middle = pendingSoleMiddle17(); $outer = pendingSoleOuter17();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); echo "H|", $middle->current() === false ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child);
$answer = $middle->send(pendingSoleDrop17()); echo "V|", $answer === false ? 1 : 0, "|E";

purpose: Pending SEND after inherited startup preserves a false first-yield flag; prior direct initialization preserves true through later synthetic outer resumption and pending SEND. Real rewind calls discriminate both histories. A real forwarded outer send then checks synthetic resume admission and preservation through a later own yield.
